description: Generate a polished HTML report with multiple DGMO diagrams, table of contents, and optional source blocks. Opens in browser by default. For DGMO syntax call get_language_reference (e.g. color a label with a trailing color name: "Sales red").

include_source.description: Show DGMO source in collapsible blocks

open.description: Open the report in the browser

sections.description: Report sections, each with a diagram

dgmo.description: DGMO diagram markup. Color a label by appending a lowercase color name as the trailing token (e.g. "Sales red"); capitalize ("Red") to use a color word as literal text.

name: generate_report
